Samira Patel: Heads up - payroll vendor switches 8/1. If I pick Roth for 401(k) catch-up in the portal, will the new vendor import that separately or merge with my regular deferral?
Evan Park: Good question. Send your employee ID so payroll can check mapping.
Samira Patel: ID 5621. Also final BrightDay pay is 7/25, first NewPay is 8/10. How are YTD catch-ups preserved? :thinking_face:
Payroll Ops: NewPay expects separate contribution codes. We rely on the transfer file. If YTD fields are ambiguous we'll post a manual adjustment on first NewPay run to preserve limits.
Benefits Bot: Note: plan allows catch-up makeups if you miss pay periods due to unpaid leave. Tax type follows election.
Samira Patel: I'm taking unpaid leave Sep 1-30. Can I schedule a one-time catch-up after return?
Payroll Ops: Yes. We can schedule a one-time contribution in Nov. It will be posted as Roth or pre-tax per your election. We'll DM you the authorization form.
Evan Park: Action: Payroll to reconcile export for 5621 and set adjustment if needed. I'll update the benefits FAQ about vendor cutovers and catch-up makeup.
Benefits Bot: Action created: Payroll Ops - reconcile export for emp 5621. Due 2024-08-05.
